prompts.name: kuksi_cover_a
prompts.prompt: A large silent national exam hall in Korea, rows of desks with test-takers wearing white doctor and nurse gowns, all bent over their answer sheets. In the center foreground, one test-taker in a white gown seen from behind and slightly above, a smartphone hidden under the desk glowing with an eerie cold blue light onto the answer sheet where every bubble is perfectly filled. The rest of the hall is in dim warm light, the blue glow is the only cold light. Frozen tense moment, like a hidden-camera news photo. Mood: unease, 'is my doctor real?'. Faces not visible. Leave the bottom 40% of the frame dark and simple for text.

prompts.name: kuksi_cover_b
prompts.prompt: Close-up from above of a desk in an exam hall: a hand in a white medical gown sleeve holding a pencil over an answer sheet where every single bubble is filled perfectly, while thin wireless earbuds and smart glasses lie half hidden under the sleeve, faint blue light reflecting on the paper. Behind, out of focus, rows of other test-takers in white gowns. Dramatic overhead spotlight, deep shadows, cold blue versus warm yellow contrast. Mood: suspicion and unease. Faces not visible. Leave the bottom 40% of the frame dark and simple for text.
